Best restaurant in Vung Tau, hands down!
Jul 2026 • Couples
As a fellow Brit, I have to say this place is an absolute gem! My third time eating here.

The food was incredible from start to finish. The biggest highlight for me was finally finding doner meat that actually tasted like back home. If you're missing a proper kebab, this is the place to come. It's an absolute must-try!

We also had the steaks and ribs, and wow... And they are so tender everytime, cooked perfectly, and packed with flavour. The portion sizes are generous, and the prices are fantastic for the quality you get.

The service was spot on too - friendly, welcoming, and nothing was too much trouble.

If you're in Vietnam and craving proper comfort food or just want an excellent meal, do yourself a favour and visit DW Bar & Grill. You won't regret it. We'll definitely be back!

Quality food in a beautiful garden setting hidden away in a quiet hem at the Front Beach at Vung Tau. Very much worth the effort
Apr 2026 • Friends
On my recent visit to VungTau I dined at DW Bar and Grill. I recall reading good things about from 2yrs ago but because it's down a quiet hem you wouldn't know about it unless a local expat took you there. Well after only one meal we were hooked. In the 5 nights I was in Vung Tau we ate there 3 times. And after I returned my Aussie friend went back several times more. He ate the same dish of Beef Stroganoff every time except one night. He proclaimed it was the best he had ever tasted and wanted to eat it every time. Lol. I tried their toasted garlic bread, crumbed Prawns, marinated mussels in a green peppercorn sauce, Sri Lankan Prawn Curry and their Thai Green Curry Prawns. My favourite was the Spicy Hot Sri Lankan Prawn Curry. Lastly their dessert of Sticky Toffee Pudding was to die for!
